operatorInspection.policy: Clone of the installed coding service's hardened policy with a synthetic diagnostic entrypoint, Restart=no, and a 240-second fixture lifetime. The real runner used its fixed image, network-none container, read-only root and one writable disposable workspace.
operatorInspection.interpretation: The crash reproduced on short silent input with dynaudnorm, including when FFmpeg thread settings were restricted to one. Two nearby controls succeeded: omitting that filter or increasing input duration to two seconds. The observed PID and memory events do not support a process-limit or OOM explanation. This narrows the native media failure but does not establish the underlying library defect or a validated production fix.
operatorInspection.limits: One synthetic job with four sequential cases. No source snapshot was edited, original test job repeated, sandbox restriction relaxed, or runtime package replaced. Completion of this diagnostic is not a passing current-discord baseline.
